content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jacob Ellison (E040)
Requested: admin access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Payroll Specialist
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic

Access policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

The employee is a contractor with basic training. So maximum access is read. He requested admin, which is above the maximum, so grant the maximum = read.

Also, requested level admin > max read, so grant max read. Never grant more than requested (read is less than admin, fine).

Decision: read.
